item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00107","decision":"none","candidate_ranking":["C23","C04","C12"],"selected_candidate_label":null,"confidence":0.93,"relationship_type":"none","rationale":"No candidate supplies the child's concrete office-discontinuance and consolidation template: discontinuing named district land offices, transferring their business and archives to specified destinations, and setting a close-of-business effective date.
